author: Ft Wayne Times
title: Jim Banks discusses GOP senators and new FBI director confirmation
text:
Rep. Jim Banks U.S. Representative for Indiana's 3rd District | Official Website
Rep. Jim Banks U.S. Representative for Indiana's 3rd District | Official Website
Jim Banks, a U.S. Congressman representing Indiana's 3rd district, has been vocal on social media regarding political appointments and issues within the government. Banks, who has served in Congress since 2017 after succeeding Marlin Stutzman, recently shared his perspectives on several developments.
On February 19, 2025, Banks tweeted a brief message regarding Republican senators: "Not all GOP senators."
The following day, February 20, he announced the confirmation of Kash Patel as FBI Director with enthusiasm: "TODAY we are confirming @Kash_Patel as FBI Director "
Later that same day, Banks expressed his views on the challenges facing the FBI under President Biden and anticipated changes under Patel’s leadership. He stated: "Time’s up for the Swamp. CONFIRMED: FBI Director @Kash_Patel Under Biden, the FBI was plagued by anti-American rot and political corruption. Kash will reform our principal law enforcement agency and fiercely defend We the People."
